skill.name: ecommerce-video-script
skill.description: 当用户需要根据商品信息撰写带货短视频、商品演示或种草口播脚本时使用。提供商品链接或商品资料，输出分镜、口播、演示动作与行动引导；可按需参考同类商品。在线商品能力支持抖音与小红书，已有资料可直接写作。来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Draft timed ecommerce video scripts from product notes, with optional product lookups on Douyin and Xiaohongshu.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The optional online workflow runs an unpinned npm package that handles a service credential, including local storage through login. The shell examples accept user inputs without specifying safe argument handling. No evidence found of an embedded payload, credential exfiltration, or prompt injection in the reviewed instructions.

remediation.issue: Online lookup and authentication run an unpinned npm package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed release, verify its provenance, and require approval before installing or executing it. Keep writing from supplied product details free of CLI calls.

remediation.issue: Shell examples do not define how to pass user input safely.
remediation.suggestion: Use structured tool calls or launch the reviewed CLI with separate arguments and no shell. Validate product IDs and supported product URLs.

remediation.issue: The CLI can persist the API key in a local JSON file.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an operating system credential store or an approved secret manager. Document how to remove stored credentials and revoke exposed keys.

content.value_statement: Product listings often lack a script that a creator can film. Turn verified product details into timed shots, narration, captions, and a call to action.
actual_capabilities: Draft scripts from supplied product facts without calling an online service.
Look up supported Douyin and Xiaohongshu products by link or platform-specific ID through SocialDataX.
Align each timed segment with a shot, demonstration action, spoken line, and on-screen caption.
Use a small set of related listings as references for script structure when the user requests it.
List props and filming preparations, record fact sources, and flag claims or demonstrations that need verification.
limitations: Online product lookup supports only Douyin and Xiaohongshu and requires authenticated SocialDataX access.
The direct CLI requires Node.js, npm, and a configured API key. An authenticated hosted MCP connection is an alternative.
Listing claims are not independently verified. Prices, offers, and proposed demonstration results still need checking.
The skill delivers text. It does not generate or publish videos, change commerce accounts, or guarantee sales.

use_cases.title: Turn a Product Brief Into a Script
use_cases.description: Use confirmed specifications to draft a short sales video with a demonstration and a clear closing line.

use_cases.title: Plan a Phone-Filmed Product Demo
use_cases.description: Match narration and captions to shots that fit the available props, filming setup, and runtime.

use_cases.title: Build a Source-Checked Creative Brief
use_cases.description: Use a small set of related listings for structure while keeping product claims tied to the featured item.

prompt_templates.title: Draft From Product Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: You have confirmed facts and want a first draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a 15-second video script for [product] using only [confirmed facts]. Include timed shots, narration, captions, and a call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt to a Filming Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: You know the audience and filming constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a [duration]-second demo for [audience] using [product facts]. Plan shots we can film with [equipment and props]. List any demonstrations we need to verify.

prompt_templates.title: Draft From a Supported Listing
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a supported product link and approved online access.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this [Douyin or Xiaohongshu product link] to draft a 30-second script. Cite the listing and flag any price or promotion terms that need checking.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Distinct Script Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: You have approved online access and want related listings for creative reference.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [target listing] and up to three related listings on the same platform. Use the references only for structure. Write a 30-second script using confirmed target facts. List the sources and unresolved claims.

output_examples.input: Write a 15-second phone video for a 500 mL travel cup with a twist lid. Do not claim heat retention.
output: 0-4 seconds. Frame the cup on a desk. Narration: Here is a 500 mL travel cup. Caption: 500 mL capacity.
4-11 seconds. Film a close-up of the lid turning. Narration: Twist the lid to open or close it. Caption: Twist lid.
11-15 seconds. Return to the full cup. Narration: Check the product details before ordering. Caption: View product details.
Props: cup and phone stand. Source: user-provided product details. No heat retention claim.

output_examples.input: Plan a 20-second demo for a 30 cm desk tray with two compartments. The material and current price are unknown.
output: 0-5 seconds. Show the tray beside a notebook. Narration: Set aside a spot for small desk items. Caption: Desk tray.
5-15 seconds. Place clips and erasers in separate compartments. Narration: Use the two compartments to separate them. Caption: Two compartments.
15-20 seconds. Show the tray next to a ruler. Narration: Check whether 30 centimeters fits your desk. Caption: 30 cm.
Source: user-provided product details. Confirm material and current price before mentioning either.

best_practices: Provide verified product facts, the intended audience, the target duration, and the equipment available for filming.
Check current prices, promotion terms, and any demonstration results before filming or publishing.
Keep API keys out of chat and use an approved SocialDataX connection for online work.
anti_patterns: Requesting market-wide research when a few relevant examples are sufficient.
Reusing a competitor's specifications, certifications, or product claims in the featured script.
Treating missing test results, stock levels, or discounts as verified facts.

faq.question: Can I write a script without an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply enough product details to write the script without an online lookup.

faq.question: Which product links can the skill read?
faq.answer: Online lookup supports Douyin and Xiaohongshu product links and their corresponding IDs. Paste the product details for other platforms.

faq.question: How long is the default script?
faq.answer: The default is 30 seconds. Specify a different duration to change the segment timing.

faq.question: Does the skill search for competing products?
faq.answer: Only when requested. It uses up to three related listings for structure, not as evidence about the featured product.

faq.question: What happens when a product detail is missing?
faq.answer: The draft uses known facts and lists missing or conflicting details for you to check.

faq.question: Can the skill make or post the video?
faq.answer: No. It provides a text script and filming notes. It does not generate or publish videos.
